# DeviceIQ feature and test traceability

**Current website update (24 November 2026):** Public browse, comparison, and detail routes use the reviewed slice of `outputs/deviceiq-inventory-2026-11-24/` generated by `scripts/build_public_catalog.py`: 28 models across all three categories. The larger inventory remains provisional. Pending, unresolved-date, and held-out records are retained for research and do not appear as eligible products. The former pilot and its test fixtures described below are preserved for reproducibility; the public-snapshot eligibility and provenance checks run in the same catalog test suite.

## Prior pilot verification record

Dataset version: `2026-11-23-initial-30`. Website implementation checked 23 November 2026 (Philippine time). The planned inclusion window is **1 January 2021 to 30 November 2026**, inclusive. The end date has not arrived at the time of this implementation.

The three questions below are **provisional panel instructions**, not an edited manuscript. The latest local `DeviceIQ_Revised_Thesis.docx` still asks about personalized smartphone/tablet recommendations, weighted scores and rankings. It omits laptops. The panel-approved filter-only scope in the task therefore differs materially from that file; the manuscript needs a separate authorized revision.

| Provisional question | Implemented feature | Verification |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1. Which measurable specifications and product information document Philippine smartphones, tablets and laptops in the inclusion window? | Category-specific model/configuration records, units, official Philippine source links, observed date, separate release and local availability fields, condition and price evidence. Missing fields read “Not verified.” | `scripts/test-catalog.ts` checks category counts, source links and price provenance. `docs/CATALOG_COVERAGE.md` records the current gaps. |
| 2. Which functions support device selection, product information, browsing and filtering? | Category choice before Browse, separate filters, detail pages, category-limited comparison, browser-local saved records and sign-in. | Catalog UI inspection and category tests S01–S06, T01–T07 and L01–L05. |
| 3. Do category-specific filters return expected eligible records in predefined cases? | Deterministic AND across fields, OR within multiselects, inclusive minimum thresholds, exact CPU/chipset/GPU choices, sort before first ten, pagination and no-match state. | `npm run test:catalog`; expected IDs are hard-coded independently from filter output and compared to observed IDs. |

## Verification record

The automated suite prints category, dataset version, active filters, expected IDs, observed IDs, software version, test date, status and note for each case. On 23 November 2026 it recorded **22 passed, 0 failed**. The pagination fixture has 12 records and checks both pages. Each real starter set has 10 configurations, so real-data second-page behavior needs a larger sourced dataset to exercise it. Browser checks confirmed desktop and phone layouts, category navigation by keyboard, mobile filter toggling, exact category results, same-category comparison, saved configurations and source-linked details. These UI checks are not counted in the automated result.

## Outstanding research decisions

- The official Philippine pages prove a local listing was present when observed. Most do not state the original Philippine launch date or model release date. Confirm whether an observed official listing suffices for study inclusion or whether a dated launch announcement is mandatory for every record.
- Ten new smartphone configurations use official Philippine manufacturer pages. The existing illustrative smartphone seed catalog still lacks a complete local evidence trail and remains outside the filter catalog.
- Several tablet pages document specifications but no verified Philippine price. Price filters are hidden when no recorded value exists. Lifecycle status is unverified, so no item is labeled discontinued or given a used price.
- The 30 records are a pilot set, not evidence that all eligible brands, models, variants, laptop types or price categories have been enumerated.
